mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that heighten recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE increase >0.5pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with concurrent HOUST and RSAFS declines, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO <90.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL YoY above 2.5% indicate aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL YoY >2.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals weakening economic momentum that reduces corporate revenue outlook, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of GDPC1 <1.5% annualized periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
